subject.title: [Bug]: Managed node install can retain invalid Gateway connection settings

question: Should maintainers keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103093 as the canonical fix for this credential and TLS-retargeting issue, or split/defer the security-sensitive managed-node repair?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the fix changes persisted Gateway credentials, systemd EnvironmentFile behavior, uninstall scrubbing, and TLS pinning inheritance under a protected maintainer-labeled issue.

options.title: Use the linked fix PR
options.body: Resolve the remaining review blocker on the linked PR, keep its managed-node credential/TLS tests, and close this issue only after merge.

options.title: Split the managed-node fix
options.body: Move only the password/env-file/TLS-retargeting repair into a narrower PR if maintainers want to decouple it from the broader Gateway/node liveness changes.

options.title: Defer protected work
options.body: Leave the issue assigned without queueing another automated fix if maintainers want to schedule the security-sensitive service-install change later.

recommendation.title: Use the linked fix PR
recommendation.body: Resolve the remaining review blocker on the linked PR, keep its managed-node credential/TLS tests, and close this issue only after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the current assignee and has both original node daemon history and authorship on the linked candidate fix.
